source: TASK-20261106-sentry-turrets-stations-gates-sub1 (D7770-D7772, D7790-D7792). Mobile Sentry 340500-340503 = clones of the small starbase batteries without a group change (category 23, so EveJS serves shooting, ammunition and destruction): 340500 Projectile <- Small Artillery Battery 16631 (group 426), 340501 Hybrid <- Small Railgun Battery 16690 (group 449), 340502 Laser <- Small Beam Laser Battery 17167 (group 430), 340503 Missile <- Cruise Missile Battery 16696 (group 417). Blueprints 340510-340513 = clones of Spatial Attunement Unit Blueprint 33196 (like the PI and drill blueprints, D693/D700) with the battery blueprint group 854/855/853/871 (category 9). Copying, research and maxProductionLimit = vanilla Small Artillery/Small Railgun/Small Beam Laser/Cruise Missile Battery Blueprint 2816/2815/2826/2823 (SDE 3396210 blueprints.jsonl), no invention. iconID: the client tool needs one on every type (D7790); the batteries carry none, so the client keeps the battery look and only the server row gets the icon of the battery's weapon component (389/349/352/169); the blueprints keep 33196's own icon 2185. marketGroupID null: no market on the server. Client: re-run ApplyClientData. v2 (FEATURE-20261107-mobile-sentry-plain-materials, D8500-D8505): manufacturing = SDE T1 weapon minerals (Trit/Pye/Mex) + 5000 Trit/2500 Pye/600 Mex in place of the Power Core: 340510/340511 = 7729/2648/771, 340512 = 7200/3309/621, 340513 = 8258/5426/707; manufacturing time and skills unchanged.

overrides.name: Mobile Sentry (Projectile)
overrides.description: Self-contained sentry gun built from a starbase battery. Launch it from your cargo, then Anchor it 5-30 km from a stargate, an NPC station or your corporation's Upwell structure (low/null/wormhole space only). No control tower and no fuel. Load ammunition into it like a starbase battery: medium projectile ammunition, as the Small Artillery Battery. Shoots NPC ships of factions hostile to you; never shoots players. Destructible.
